notes.title: Major update v2.0
notes.notes: [h2]Fiz and the Rainbow Planet v2.0 now available![/h2][p]The details of this update are as follows:[/p][p][/p][p][b]【English text support】[/b][/p][p]A language selection screen will now appear when you start the game for the first time.[/p][p]You can also change the language at any time by going to “Options → Other Settings → Language Settings.”[/p][p][b]【Mild Mode Added】[/b][/p][p]When enabled, the slightly strong expressions added in previous updates will be toned down.[/p][p]This setting is enabled by default, so if you want to play with the same expressions as in the previous version,[/p][p]please switch it off from “Options → Graphics Settings → MILD MODE.”[/p][p][b]【Other Changes】[/b][/p][p]• Reduced processing load on some stages[/p][p]• Various bug fixes[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43565882/65bcafe3d07b77414c059fad4d4dcc3f3c0dd856.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43565882/5da189d3fd32621e6d02c9c9a44d6d7b28ffa50b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43565882/b463c65d589149102044b07987b2d828bb7afbf9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Fiz and the Rainbow Planet 1st Anniversary!
notes.notes: [p]The Steam version of [b]“Fiz and the Rainbow Planet”[/b] was released on July 16, 2024 (JST), and today marks its first anniversary! We sincerely thank everyone who has played the game so far.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you’ll continue to support Nijiiro-Dragon and “Fiz and the Rainbow Planet” in the years to come![/p][p][/p][p]We’re also planning to release an update to Version 2.0, including English localization, in mid-August, so please look forward to it![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43565882/86ec8f1baa8651357cf92feb35aeb77ac87d7f2b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Minor update v1.5.2
notes.notes:
This update includes the following:

・Added controller vibration support (Xbox-compatible controllers only).
・Fixed an issue where the game could become unplayable in certain high-frame-rate environments.
・Adjusted the unlock conditions for the theater room.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43565882/4eccf3482c025a9051e5c91a5e85625e5cd6baf5.png[/img]

notes.title: Minor update v1.5.1
notes.notes:
This update includes the following

After the tutorial, it is now possible to return to the “Fiz's house”.
Fixed a bug in which volume settings were not reflected in some background music.
Other graphic enhancements

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43565882/0c9ac8d8a429731560fec90ef71c9a4f6a7f162c.png[/img]

Steam client checks have been added.
　Please contact us if you encounter any problems due to the above check function.

notes.title: Major update v1.5.0
notes.notes:
Fiz and the Rainbow Planet v1.5.0 Available now!

This update includes the following:

Addition of mini-games
Addition of theater room
Improved display settings
Addition of 16:9 frame
Other graphic enhancements
Other bug fixes

*If you have already cleared the main game, the mini-games will be unlocked when you play stages 2-2 and 3-3.

notes.title: Minor update v1.0.6
notes.notes:
- Added clear rate display to time attack mode result
- Improved player behavior
- Bug fixes

notes.title: v1.0.5 minor version up
notes.notes:
This update includes the following:

-Improved behavior on slopes (characters are less likely to float!)
-Fixed typos
-Some art corrections
-Bug fixes
-Improved special effects such as game overs
-Reduced package size (1.27GB => 1.03GB)

notes.title: v1.0.4 minor version up
notes.notes:
This update includes the following:

-Fixed an issue where Leafer's special attack would go through walls
-Fixed a bug that prevented progress from being stopped
-Fixed an issue where the game would slow down if you made a mistake when defeating a boss
-Fixed an issue where sound effects would continue to play in some stages
-Fixed some BGM
-Fixed some dialogue
-Fixed some special effects

notes.title: v1.0.3 minor version up
notes.notes:
This update fixes the following:

- Fixed tutorial text for stage 5

- Fixed text on pause screen

- Fixed issue where players could enter another world in stage 5

- Fixed issue where time attack mode was not being measured correctly

notes.title: “Fiz and the Rainbow Planet” officially released!
notes.notes:
Nijiiro-Dragon started distributing the Steam version of “Fiz and Rainbow Planet” on July 16, 2024!

A unique dragon children run around with the simple operation of three buttons.
A pixel art action game that transcends dimensions
[b]Enjoy “Fiz and the Rainbow Planet”[/b]!

(Currently, only Japanese language is supported.)
